name: Northstar Robotics
summary: A fictional robotics company seeking funding to build a small pilot production line.
winnerBriefing: Northstar has secured a signed pilot order from a regional logistics operator. The first production line is already designed, but delivery milestones depend on reliable component supply. Winning teams may use this briefing when discussing the deal with the event team.

name: Cedar Grove Foods
summary: A fictional food producer seeking capital to expand its regional distribution network.
winnerBriefing: Cedar Grove has a growing base of repeat wholesale customers. Its expansion plan depends on refrigerated distribution capacity and careful working-capital management during seasonal demand peaks.

name: Blueglass Energy
summary: A fictional clean-energy startup seeking a loan to install a demonstration facility.
winnerBriefing: Blueglass has obtained a site permit for its demonstration facility and is negotiating a long-term power purchase agreement. Equipment lead times and the timing of that agreement remain important execution risks.
